sections.chapter_title: Controller area network with flexible data rate (FDCAN)
sections.text_helper: Section 71.5.24 "FDCAN new data 1 register (FDCAN_NDAT1)" in chapter 71 (Controller area network with flexible data rate (FDCAN)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3703.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x0098
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:0 ND[31:0]: New data[31:0]
The register holds the new data flags of Rx buffers 0 to 31. The flags are set when the respective Rx
buffer has been updated from a received frame. The flags remain set until the user clears them. A
flag is cleared by writing a 1 to the corresponding bit position. Writing a 0 has no effect. A hard reset
clears the register.
0: Rx buffer not updated
1: Rx buffer updated from new message
